caption:
Kind words over charity that hurts

Allah tells us that kind words and forgiveness are better than charity followed by hurt, and that He is Self-Sufficient, Most Forbearing. Today, let your words and your patience with people be a gift of their own.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:263

Who will hear a kind word from you before noon today?

#kindwords #forgiveness #goodcharacter #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
